ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level dominance of low-intensity (black) pixels across >90% of the visible surface; high-intensity (white/grey) pixels are localized to distal tip clusters and sparse linear/circular marks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity dark field across both lobes; distal tips (left and right) exhibit high-contrast white/tan clusters; right lobe contains several hollow circular high-contrast ring patterns in the upper quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an acute interior angle estimated at 55 degrees; notch depth occupies approximately 20% of the total vertical fluke height visible above water.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and jagged continuous boundary with high-frequency serrations; pixel-amplitude variations are most pronounced on the inner medial edges adjacent to the notch and at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature fitted to both lobes, transitioning from the central notch into an upward and outward sweep toward the distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed high-contrast white pixel clusters at the distal tips consistent with barnacle colonization; distinct circular ring-shaped scars visible on the mid-to-upper surface of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several short, unaligned high-intensity linear marks; one distinct vertical white line located near the lower central axis; sparse horizontal scratches on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Circular ring-shaped lesions on the right lobe surface; extensive sessile organism colonization (barnacles) on the outer lateral margins of both lobes.
